MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Wallflower felt like something I would try because its relaxed interpretations of familiar songs fit the mellower side of my recent listening.",
    "Revolver, Electric Light Orchestra and The Mamas & the Papas connect with my interest in melodic rock and songwriting, even though none felt compelling enough to choose today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Motown, Beach Boys and Kool & the Gang collections missed my current blues and roots rock mood; being familiar older music was not enough to make them appealing.",
    "25 and Cheek to Cheek leaned toward pop ballads or vocal standards when I wanted something closer to my recent blues and singer-songwriter listening.",
    "I could not connect Greatest Hits to my interests without knowing the artist, so I had no reason to choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in some classic rock seemed to be taken as interest in a broad range of older music, although the sound and mood matter more to me than the era.",
    "The many greatest-hits collections seemed to assume I wanted familiar favorites, while my recent choices suggest interest in particular albums and artists."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The blues and roots rock thread connecting Memphis, Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels deserved more weight in what came next.",
    "My latest choice, You Should Be So Lucky, made the singer-songwriter side of my interests especially relevant; I wanted that musical connection rather than just another recognizable name.",
    "A partial match rarely gets me to act: I would try Wallflower now, while leaving the other somewhat appealing albums for another visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in melodic, familiar music but stretched it too broadly beyond the blues, roots rock and relaxed songwriting I wanted now."
}
